'''Ben Lacey''' of Franklin, Tennessee, attended [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Decipher's caption called him one half of the Lacey gang.<ref name="sat49">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000612214619/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat49.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat49], Decipher (Wayback 12 June 2000). Caption: "Ben Lacey, one half of the Lacey gang, the tough crew from Franklin, Tennessee"</ref>
